sourceFile: Copy of 161016 and 201506 TEST REPAIR NG FUNCTION_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable context but its changed-factor and outcome grouping are too mixed for final evidence.
issues: Changed factor conflates repair method, voltage levels, module tests, dates, and lines.
Baseline and test conditions are ambiguous across normal, spec normal, and voltage normal.
Outcomes mix SPK repair validation, S921 module function, voltage hearing checks, and E2 process defects.
Several measurement outcomes are derived from headers or incompatible numeric fields.
Subgroup keys are nonsensical and omit needed model, sheet, date, line, and test-stage grouping.
correctionPlan: Define primary factor as NG hearing repair method with voltage-level variants only where supported.
Separate or clearly subgroup SPK repair validation, voltage-up hearing test, and S921 module confirmation.
Remove unrelated date/line process-defect series unless tied to the same repair validation.
Rebuild outcomes using paired rows with matching model, date, line, voltage condition, and test stage.
Drop header-only measurement statistics and keep only citeable row-level metrics.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but current citations do not sufficiently support the draft grouping.
